svg.title: BSWorld architecture with virtual Controllers and complete firmware
svg.desc: Native and UML Hosts connect to Zephyr Controller processes or Python BSController instances through dedicated H4 Unix sockets. Bumble Hosts, Python Controller worker threads and the framework clock belong to the BSWorld pytest process. The H4 server is owned by the Controller worker and runs on its event loop. Each Controller radio and clock participant has a separate FIFO endpoint to the shared BabbleSim PHY. A UML guest does not join the PHY; it receives its clock from the pytest event loop through a UML time-travel socket. A legend in the lower left identifies the H4 Unix socket, Radio FIFO, Clock FIFO and time-travel socket connection types. Zephyr and Python Controllers write HCI snoop directly to per-instance files using local simulation timestamps. Complete Zephyr firmware contains its own Host, Controller and radio and joins the PHY through its own radio FIFO without an HCI socket. BSWorld converts PHY transmission CSV files to Ellisys at teardown.
svg.text: Virtual Controllers and complete firmware on one shared PHY and simulation timeline
BLE modem · channel attenuation · shared simulation time
RF capture from every radio on the PHY
H4 Unix socket · HCI between Host and Controller
Radio FIFO · Controller or firmware radio to the PHY
Clock FIFO · Host or framework simulation clock
Time-travel socket · UML guest clock from pytest
